findings.text: follow-on: the comment states a Choice whose options the rule cannot split is refused at table construction, but _question_def (jev_review.py:290) builds the criteria dict with no such refusal and check_failed (jev_review.py:322) reads options[0] as the acceptable form unconditionally, so a mis-authored options list is mis-decided silently, exactly the outcome the comment claims is prevented.

follow-on: an audit-decided check is recorded answered True even when audit_report is None, so an audit that never ran reads as answered-and-not-failed (unknown as pass), inconsistent with the module's own rule at jev_review.py:135 that an absent call is never read as an acceptance.
follow-on: the constant comment cites "the cascade of the plan", a forward reference to a plan deliverable in a source comment, which the repository naming rules keep out of code.

follow-on: the recorded baseline_suite.command names UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/scratch-venv while gate-base.log's header names the main .venv, so the recorded literal command does not match the command the log shows; the result (22 passed) is unaffected.
